definitions.explanation: A small, tucked-away corner or section of a larger space. Often implies a quiet, inconspicuous, or marginal location. Used both literally for physical spaces and figuratively for peripheral areas of larger domains.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I sat in a corner of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}いていた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Small flowers were blooming in a corner of the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{暮|く}らしたい→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes I think I'd like to live quietly in a corner of this world.

notes:
USAGE:
Often preceded by a location + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ} (a corner of the room), ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ} (a corner of the city). Carries a nuance of being small, quiet, or overlooked, unlike ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧ (a geometric corner) or ⟦{隅|すみ}→隅：01625_sumi⟧ (a corner of a room). The phrase ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ} (a corner of the world) was popularized by the animated film of the same title.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}: a corner of one's heart
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}: a corner of the world
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}: a corner of one's memory
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{片隅|かたすみ}: a nook of the city
